006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter.MetaschemaDataTypeProvider;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.DateTimeFunctionException;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.InvalidValueForCastFunctionException;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.impl.DayTimeDurationItemImpl;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IAtomicOrUnionType;
013import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.InvalidTypeMetapathException;
014import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
015
016import java.time.Duration;
017import java.time.ZoneOffset;
018
019import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
020
021/**
022 * An atomic Metapath item containing a duration data value in days, hours, and
023 * seconds.
024 */
025public interface IDayTimeDurationItem extends IDurationItem {
026  /**
027   * Get the type information for this item.
028   *
029   * @return the type information
030   */
031  @NonNull
032  static IAtomicOrUnionType<IDayTimeDurationItem> type() {
033    return MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.DAY_TIME_DURATION.getItemType();
034  }
035
036  @Override
037  default IAtomicOrUnionType<IDayTimeDurationItem> getType() {
038    return type();
039  }
040
041  /**
042   * Construct a new day time duration item using the provided string
043   * {@code value}.
044   *
045   * @param value
046   *          a string representing a day time duration
047   * @return the new item
048   * @throws InvalidTypeMetapathException
049   *           if the provided string value is not a day/time duration value
050   *           according to ISO 8601
051   */
052  @NonNull
053  static IDayTimeDurationItem valueOf(@NonNull String value) {
054    try {
055      return valueOf(MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.DAY_TIME_DURATION.parse(value));
056    } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
057      throw new InvalidTypeMetapathException(
058          null,
059          String.format("Invalid day/time value '%s',",
060              value),
061          ex);
062    }
063  }
064
065  /**
066   * Construct a new day time duration item using the provided {@code value}.
067   *
068   * @param value
069   *          a duration
070   * @return the new item
071   */
072  @NonNull
073  static IDayTimeDurationItem valueOf(@NonNull Duration value) {
074    return new DayTimeDurationItemImpl(value);
075  }
076
077  /**
078   * Get the items wrapped value as a duration.
079   *
080   * @return the wrapped value as a duration
081   */
082  @NonNull
083  Duration asDuration();
084
085  /**
086   * Get the "wrapped" duration value in seconds.
087   *
088   * @return the underlying duration in seconds
089   */
090  default long asSeconds() {
091    return asDuration().toSeconds();
092  }
093
094  /**
095   * Returns a copy of this duration with the amount negated.
096   *
097   * @return this duration with the amount negated
098   */
099  @NonNull
100  default IDayTimeDurationItem negate() {
101    return valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(asDuration().negated()));
102  }
103
104  /**
105   * Cast the provided type to this item type.
106   *
107   * @param item
108   *          the item to cast
109   * @return the original item if it is already this type, otherwise a new item
110   *         cast to this type
111   * @throws InvalidValueForCastFunctionException
112   *           if the provided {@code item} cannot be cast to this type
113   */
114  @NonNull
115  static IDayTimeDurationItem cast(@NonNull IAnyAtomicItem item) {
116    try {
117      return item instanceof IDayTimeDurationItem
118          ? (IDayTimeDurationItem) item
119          : valueOf(item.asString());
120    } catch (IllegalStateException | InvalidTypeMetapathException ex) {
121      // asString can throw IllegalStateException exception
122      throw new InvalidValueForCastFunctionException(ex);
123    }
124  }
125
126  @Override
127  default IDayTimeDurationItem castAsType(IAnyAtomicItem item) {
128    return cast(item);
129  }
130
131  /**
132   * Compares this value with the argument.
133   *
134   * @param item
135   *          the item to compare with this value
136   * @return a negative integer, zero, or a positive integer if this value is less
137   *         than, equal to, or greater than the {@code item}.
138   */
139  default int compareTo(@NonNull IDayTimeDurationItem item) {
140    return asDuration().compareTo(item.asDuration());
141
142  }
143
144  /**
145   * Get a zone offset for this duration.
146   *
147   * @return the offset
148   * @throws DateTimeFunctionException
149   *           with code
150   *           {@link DateTimeFunctionException#INVALID_TIME_ZONE_VALUE_ERROR} if
151   *           the offset is &lt; -PT14H or &gt; PT14H
152   */
153  @NonNull
154  ZoneOffset asZoneOffset();
155}
